callLines.line: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.

anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Rosa Diallo. From Stonebridge." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 2 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Cole Dubois. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Thornfield in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Priya Osei and Ruth Santos and Fatima Sato and Tariq Dubois will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Stonebridge answers! Kira Sato and Kenji Kim will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Alba Olsen and Rosa Ortiz will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)

🛡️ Aroha, Vera, Nora step forward. They will march with the muster, eat from your stores (1000 kcal/day each), and stand in front of THE HERALD. They can die — Haven does not get them back, and the fire will be quieter. Tap again — Haven sends its own.
🛡️ Haven commits its own: Aroha, Vera, Nora march with the muster. Not loaned. Not asked-for. Ours. The coalition counts 11 blades against THE HERALD — it needs 10.
